title: Data Engineering Intern, Marshall Wace (UK)
content: Architected an automated data-lineage discovery platform for the data engineering team in London. Built an interactive graph visualisation in React and Mantine on top of a FastAPI backend that orchestrates an end-to-end lineage-extraction pipeline, cutting tracing times from hours to under three seconds across multi-database schemas. Integrated Kerberos-authenticated OAuth, SQL Server temporal tables, Prometheus metrics, and structured logging to improve observability, achieving 100% audit compliance and sub-50 ms diagnostic latency. Implemented an MCP server enabling interactive graph refinement and programmatic AI tool execution across multi-team workflows, automating over 80% of manual query-auditing tasks.

title: Application Development Intern, Morgan Stanley (UK)
content: Worked on large-scale data migration and simulation projects within the equities technology team in Glasgow, and received a return offer. Developed Java-based ETL pipelines on Linux using Spring Boot to migrate 10B+ historical equity swap records from legacy databases into Snowflake, reducing processing time by 20%. Engineered database connections between on-premises systems and Snowflake, freeing up 15% capacity in production databases. Implemented a stochastic model to randomise stock values for a trading simulation, to better emulate market volatility.

title: Informatics Course Tutor, University of Edinburgh (UK)
content: Tutored 80+ first-year students in functional programming. Designed and delivered tutorials on recursion, higher-order functions, lazy evaluation, monads, and type systems. Ran coding challenges in Haskell that boosted average performance by 15%. Evaluated and provided feedback on 100+ assignments, helping students write efficient and idiomatic functional code.

title: Spring Insight Programs – Maven Securities, Meta, Blackstone, Morgan Stanley, SIG (UK)
content: Completed multi-firm technology and finance training in London covering quantitative modelling, high-performance Python/C++ systems, trading infrastructure, and large-scale data analysis. Engaged in high-intensity workshops, live trading simulations, and risk management exercises, and learned about proprietary trading methodologies and the role of technology in modern markets.

title: Website Migration Intern, University of Edinburgh (UK)
content: Migrated 100+ official university websites to EdWeb2 (Drupal CMS). Built and restructured web pages, fixed JavaScript errors, and debugged HTML inconsistencies. Conducted QA testing for content accuracy, layout consistency, and accessibility compliance. Improved digital experience for 4.5M annual users by ensuring usability and reliability.
